bifrost: springboard/src/files/zip.rs (create, extract), springboard/apps/files/src/main.rs (compress_now, extract_now), springboard/src/shell/store/install.rs (read_tar, index_tar, extract_from), springboard/src/shell/books/engine/inflate.rs, springboard/src/shell/books/engine/zip.rs
summary: BifrOSt has zip create and extract in the Files app and its system file layer, tar reading and extraction for app package install, and DEFLATE decoding for the Books engine. None of this is exposed through an SDK API, and the Apple Archive stream, string, metadata-preserving and encrypted formats are not present.

features.feature: Compressing and extracting file system directories
features.apple: Compressing file system directories; Decompressing and extracting an archived directory
features.note: Wave 4 (w4-apple-archive, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Zip folder trees via the Files app; no SDK API; Apple's Apple Archive format is not used

features.apple: Compressing single files; Decompressing single files
features.note: Wave 4 (w4-apple-archive, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Files app writes name.zip for one file; covered by a round-trip test; no SDK call

features.apple: Compressing and saving a string to the file system; Decompressing and parsing an archived string
features.note: Wave 4 (w4-apple-archive, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No string-level archive API in the SDK or the system layer

features.apple: ArchiveHeader; file ownership, permissions, flags, times, extended attributes
features.note: Tar entries keep mode only; the zip path was not checked for ownership, times or xattr preservation

features.feature: Archive streams (data blobs and byte buffers)
features.note: Streaming is internal to read_tar and index_tar; no public stream type for apps

features.feature: Reading and indexing tar packages for install
features.apple: No direct equivalent; closest is the archive read path
features.note: Used by the App Store installer; headers are indexed without loading file data; not an app-facing API
Decoder lives in the Books engine; not verified which book formats use it; no compression side
No encrypted archive format found in the code searched

gaps: No SDK API for creating or extracting archives; apps cannot use the Files app zip code
No Apple Archive format (AAR) reader or writer, with its header and stream model
No multithreaded compression; the zip creator runs as a single background job
No preservation of file ownership, extended attributes or flags in archives, as far as the code shows
No encrypted archives or encryption context
No string or byte-buffer compression API
